· 현 구간 진단 (상승추세): 스윙 지지선($11.08) 근접 시 매수 진입 조건 충족
analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($11.18) vs SMA5 ($9.88)/SMA20 ($9.51)/SMA50 ($9.13): Confirms short-to-mid-term trend above moving averages.
· Above SMA100 ($10.36), below SMA200 ($12.96): Indicates a transition phase in the medium-to-long-term trend.
· 52-week position (8.6%) + Current price level is significantly higher from historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (49.9 → 65.3): Exited oversold territory, established in neutral zone, and entering overbought.
· MACD histogram trajectory (0.0136 → 0.1334): Improving, signaling bullish expansion.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Upper Band $10.50): Approaching the upper band.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($11.08): Near current price, based on pivot.
· Swing resistance ($11.85): Potential for further upside on breakout.
· 5-day low ($8.78) > 20-day low ($8.53): Confirms Higher Low pattern.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (2.32x): High confidence in the upward movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Uptrend): Meeting buy entry conditions near swing support ($11.08).
